{{Quote|But I can help you. ''I'' can be your friend. Spare my life&mdash;leave me in my position here&mdash;and I can create a refuge where you'll be safe when it all falls apart around you&mdash;|Judge Lamos Chatoor, to Emperor's Hand Mara Jade|<ref name="Choices" />}}
[[Judge/Legends|Judge]] [[Lamos Chatoor]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] worked at a '''courthouse'''.<ref name="Choices" /> In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="ChoicesD">The events of ''[[Choices of One]]'' take place in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] according to ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]].</ref> [[Emperor's Hand]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] visited the building to [[Death/Legends|kill]] the judge after discovering that Chatoor had used [[Gender/Legends|his]] position to further himself and his supporters. As Jade prepared to eliminate Chatoor near the judge's desk, two gunmen entered a courtroom within Chatoor's courthouse and made their way to the site of the Emperor's Hand confrontation with the judge. They attempted to shoot Jade with their [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]]; however, the Imperial agent deflected their shots, killing them. Chatoor then offered to create a refuge for Jade when the Empire fell, prompting the Emperor's Hand to kill him.<ref name="Choices" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lamos Chatoor's courthouse appeared in the [[2011]] novel ''[[Choices of One]]'', which was written by [[Timothy Zahn]].<ref name="Choices" />
